evidences.caption: Indian diplomat Devyani Khobragade leaves after visiting Chaitya Bhoomi, a memorial to Indian freedom fighter B.R. Ambedkar, in Mumbai, Jan 14, 2013. Khobragade, India's deputy consul general in New York, was indicted by a US federal grand jury on accusations that she exploited her Indian-born housekeeper and nanny, allegedly having her work more than 100 hours a week for low pay and lying about it on a visa form. She denies the charge.  Photo by AP
